duplicate_rule: same group when any of: same v1 group; pHash<=6 and dHash<=8; flip/rotation-invariant ResNet18 cosine>=0.92; ORB+RANSAC inliers>=30 with cosine>=0.85 (or inliers>=80 within a species)
session_rule: same session when the duplicate rule holds with cosine>=0.90 instead of 0.92; sessions with 30+ candidate photos are kept out of val/test; a val/test class takes at most 10 photos from one session
session_balance: the fabric/notebook tomato session has equal fresh and rotten counts in train (42/42) so its background cannot signal the label

leakage_audit.note: pairs above 0.91 were inspected by eye: different photos

source_metadata.note: Kaggle muhriddinmuxiddinov/fruits-and-vegetables-dataset (1,140 of 1,200 photos); the other 60 cucumbers are from swoyam2609/fresh-and-stale-classification v1, see manifest.csv

kaggle_metadata.subtitleNullable: Determining freshness of fruits and vegetables
kaggle_metadata.descriptionNullable:
# Context

This dataset contains images of the following fruits and vegetables items:

Fresh fruits- fresh banana, fresh apple, fresh orange, fresh mango and fresh strawberry.
Rotten fruits- rotten banana, rotten apple, rotten orange, rotten mango and rotten strawberry.
Fresh vegetables- fresh potato, fresh cucumber, fresh carrot, fresh tomato and fresh bell pepper.
Rotten vegetables- rotten potato, rotten cucumber, rotten carrot, rotten tomato and rotten bell pepper.

# Content

This dataset contains two folders:

Fruits (5997 images for 10 classes)
Vegetables (6003 images for 10 classes)
each of the above folders contains subfolders for different fruits and vegetables wherein the images for respective food items are present

This dataset gathered from different online sources, such as Google images, Bing images, Kaggle, Fruit360  and Sriram R.K.,
which provided samples of the pure-fresh category and a single item with a white background, respectively.

**Please cite the following research paper:**
Mukhiddinov, Mukhriddin, Azamjon Muminov, and Jinsoo Cho. 2022. "Improved Classification Approach for Fruits and Vegetables Freshness Based on Deep Learning" Sensors 22, no. 21: 8192. https://doi.org/10.3390/s22218192

v3_addition.split_rule: v2 duplicate rule plus same-photo pairs judged by eye (review/v3_same_photo_pairs.json); the publisher's own 224x224 photo shoot of each fresh class is one session kept in train; per vegetable, fresh and rotten have the same counts (val/test 30, train = what the scarcer condition allows)

leakage_audit.note: all new val/test-train pairs with cosine >= 0.86 were inspected by eye; copies and same-object stock series were grouped and the split rebuilt
